children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions announced orders for nine ROSA units licensed with SARA, slated for deployment by end of October 2026.
RAD received orders for nine standalone ROSA units, each licensed with SARA, for automotive and construction sites.
Six units are for a major national automotive retailer via an established security dealer—first business with that end customer.
Three units expand deployments for a longstanding construction customer and early RAD adopter.
All nine units are expected to be deployed by the end of October, during the company's Q3 fiscal 2027.
Company positions ROSA as the core of its stationary security platform, driving recurring revenue and integration with SARA, RIO and ROAMEO.
